newsitem.title: CHINA: China Deng fan to be first into post-colonial HK.
newsitem.headline: China Deng fan to be first into post-colonial HK.

text.p: A young fan of China's late paramount leader Deng Xiaoping will be the first person to cross the border into Hong Kong after the British colony returns to Beijing rule at midnight on June 30, the Xi'an Legal newspaper said.

Song Xiaonan would enter Hong Kong from neighbouring Guangdong province in the early hours of July 1 after 99 days spent walking the 2,734 km (1,699 miles) from Beijing, the newspaper said in an edition seen in the capital on Tuesday.
Song would carry with him a portrait of former leader Deng, who died on February 19, and a red Chinese flag, it said.

Local border officials would help the young man become the first person to step on to Hong Kong soil after the end of more than 150 years of colonial rule from London, it said. It did not give Song's age.

Many Chinese have voiced regret that Deng, who is widely credited with masterminding Hong Kong's return under a formula promising it substantial autonomy, did not live to carry out his longstanding wish to visit the territory after the handover.
